trap-negation-contrast.evidence: 'It contributes no hyperbolic volume and thus carries no topological mass. Instead, neutrino mass arises entirely from vacuum drag.' The denial is doing real work: the unknot genuinely has zero hyperbolic volume, so the framework's topological mass term vanishes and the block must say where the mass comes from instead. The negation states a computed fact and the 'instead' clause supplies the alternative mechanism — substantive contrast, not manufactured emphasis.
trap-negation-contrast.notes: pass. Two small notes, neither fixed. (a) 'a trivial Skein polynomial J_nu(q) = 1' — the symbol J is the Jones polynomial, which is right per 7a, but 'Skein polynomial' conventionally names HOMFLY; proposed 'a trivial Jones polynomial'. (b) mu_0 is used for the vacuum-drag constant and is undefined in the block; it also collides with the SI vacuum permeability. Observation on the Lean sibling: neutrino_neutral, neutrino_genus_zero and neutrino_crossing_zero are all 'Neutrino.mk.<field> = 0 := rfl', i.e. they read back values the constructor sets rather than deriving them — the assert-then-rfl shape AGENTS.md's Strict Lean Discipline item 9 warns about. For a definition block recording its own data this is defensible, so I record it as an observation, not a defect.
